selected_pair.rationale: Most promising candidate of any in the inventory: a25 is the ONLY shard that emits per-input numerical statistics (json_per100, text_per100, multi_per100, newline_per100, rule_density_per100) — every other shard only emits compressed bytes. If any wrap path exists it must go through a25.

fixture_kind: synthetic 4096-d hidden vectors generated via Python random.Random(seed) uniform[-1,1]
selftest_interpretation: corr -0.313 is statistically indistinguishable from zero on n=6. The proxy carries effectively no information about the true L1 gate count. Increasing the sample size would not rescue this signal because hxc_a25's classification looks at byte-level token frequencies in the JSONL serialization, which are dominated by the JSON syntax overhead and not by the float values' projection-band membership.
honest_c3: Pilot was the most-generous-possible test: a25 is the only shard with any per-input numeric output. The negative result generalizes — no other shard would do better on this signal.
